nodes.label: desktop memory - how the gold-100 was drawn

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The v3 gold-100 is a balanced answerable subset of HERB, drawn by seeded (seed=0) round-robin over the HERB answer types person/content/company/pr/url with equal allocation at 20 per type, by v3/build_question_sets.py:stratified_gold, written to output/question_ids.gold100.jsonl. This is the same method v1 used to make its 100 list, where the stored file kept only {id, question, reference} and dropped type so the round-robin was not visible in the artifact although the draw was stratified. The natural mix is lopsided - person 260 down to url 20 - so a proportional draw would leave rare types with too few items to say anything per-type, while equal allocation gives each type a usable count; url has only 20 total, so 20 per type drains the whole url stratum. Report per-type on the gold-100 and do NOT compare its aggregate to HERB's published average, which is over the natural 815 mix. Unanswerables carry no type, so the gold-100 is answerable-only. CANON_AUDIT.md 2.10 records the equal-allocation caveat on v3/README as GROUNDED in spirit and AGENT-ORIGIN as written
